newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 19.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- World Health Organisation chief Hiroshi Nakajima promises help for Ivory Coast in combating Burili ulcers, a bacteriological disease that produces crippling open sores and affects at least 4,000 people in the West African country.

- State-owned Compagnie Ivoirienne du Developpement du Textile (CIDT), which overseas cotton growing and marketing in Ivory Coast, to be split into three and privatised, agriculture minister Lambert Kouassi Konan says; French cotton company CFDT already has

- Consortium led by Ivorian conglomerate SIFCA well placed to take one of two blocs of privatised state sugar company Sodesucre after opening of fresh bids; Belgian company Brasseries et Glacieres Internationales heads bidding for second bloc with group led by Commonwealth Development Corporation close
- Ivory Coast looks to cashew nut production as part of

- Clashes at Cocody University in commercial capital Abidjan between students for and against a return to classes after months of student unrest; three hurt. Students had agreed to return but opposition to single proposed exam session has complicated this.
